D/ CAESAR AVG F DOMITI [ ] ; R/ COS V

Rally ID: 19. Roman coin: A silver denarius of Domitian (AD 81-96), with horseman on reverse, minted between AD 77 and 78. Obverse: Bare head facing right. Obverse Inscription: CAESAR AVG F DOMITI [ ]. Reverse: Horse helmeted right, with hand raised. Reverse Inscription: COS V. RIC: Volume II, no. 242, p. 43. Diameter: 18.27mm. Thickness: 2.17mm. Weight: 2.9 grams. Find was photographed
